knowledge-base.overview: Hanami 2.x guardrails, clean architecture patterns, slice-based bounded contexts, dependency injection via Deps[], ROM persistence, dry-rb integration, and testing. Applies to web apps and APIs requiring strict separation between delivery (actions/views) and domain (operations/repositories). Operations return Dry::Monads::Result — never raise for domain errors.

core-principles.principle: Actions/views are delivery. Operations are business logic. Repositories are data access. Each layer references only the layer below it — never upward.
Each slice (slices/api/, slices/admin/) is an isolated module with its own actions, views, and auto-registration namespace. Cross-slice calls go through shared lib/.
Use include Deps["operations.users.create"] for DI. No globals, no singletons, no class-level state.
Operations return Success(value) or Failure(errors) from dry-monads. Actions pattern-match on the result — they never rescue domain exceptions.
Relations define schema and query scopes. Repositories expose commands and named finders. Actions never call relations directly.

guardrail.rule: Operations must return Dry::Monads::Result (Success/Failure). Never raise for domain-level errors — raise only for unexpected infrastructure failures.
guardrail.bad: def call(params) raise "Email taken" if user_repo.find_by_email(params[:email]) # ... end

guardrail.rule: Always validate request params in the action's params block and check request.params.valid? before delegating to an operation.
guardrail.good:
params do required(:user).hash do required(:email).filled(:string) required(:password).filled(:string, min_size?: 8) end end
def handle(request, response) unless request.params.valid? response.render(view, errors: request.params.errors) return end # delegate to operation end

guardrail.rule: Use parameterized queries via ROM relations. Never interpolate user data into SQL strings.
Store all secrets in Settings (config/settings.rb) loaded from ENV. Never reference ENV directly in actions, operations, or repositories.
guardrail.good:
# config/settings.rb setting :jwt_secret, constructor: Types::String
# In services/providers — read via settings.jwt_secret

guardrail.rule: Actions must be thin. Delegate all business logic to operations via Deps injection. An action handle method should be under 15 lines.
Use combine for eager loading in ROM relations. Never load associations inside loops — it causes N+1 queries.
Always paginate query results. Never call .to_a on an unscoped relation — unbounded loads crash under real data volumes.
Always call Hanami.logger.error(exception) in operation rescue blocks before returning Failure. Silent failures make debugging impossible.
Repositories wrap ROM relations — actions and operations must never call relations directly. The repository is the data access boundary.
Register external services as providers in config/providers/. Never instantiate third-party clients inline in operations.

pattern.name: Application Configuration
pattern.example:
# config/app.rb require "hanami"
module MyApp class App < Hanami::App config.actions.default_response_format = :html config.actions.content_security_policy[:default_src] = "'self'"
config.sessions = :cookie, { key: "_myapp_session", secret: settings.session_secret, expire_after: 60 * 60 * 24 * 7, } end end
# config/settings.rb module MyApp class Settings < Hanami::Settings setting :database_url, constructor: Types::String setting :session_secret, constructor: Types::String setting :jwt_secret, constructor: Types::String setting :redis_url, constructor: Types::String.optional setting :log_level, default: "info", constructor: Types::String.enum("debug", "info", "warn", "error") end end

pattern.name: Routes
pattern.example:
# config/routes.rb module MyApp class Routes < Hanami::Routes root to: "home.index"
scope "users" do get "/", to: "users.index" get "/new", to: "users.new" post "/", to: "users.create" get "/:id", to: "users.show" patch "/:id", to: "users.update" delete "/:id", to: "users.destroy" end
slice :api, at: "/api" do scope "v1" do get "/users", to: "v1.users.index" post "/users", to: "v1.users.create" get "/users/:id", to: "v1.users.show" end end end end

pattern.name: Web Action
pattern.example:
# app/actions/users/create.rb module MyApp module Actions module Users class Create < MyApp::Action include Deps["operations.users.create"]
params do required(:user).hash do required(:email).filled(:string) required(:name).filled(:string) required(:password).filled(:string, min_size?: 8) end end
def handle(request, response) unless request.params.valid? response.render(view, errors: request.params.errors) return end
result = create.call(request.params[:user])
if result.success? response.flash[:success] = "User created" response.redirect_to routes.path(:users_show, id: result.value!.id) else response.render(view, errors: result.failure) end end end end end end

pattern.name: API Slice Base Action
pattern.example:
# slices/api/action.rb module API class Action < Hanami::Action format :json
handle_exception ROM::TupleCountMismatchError => :handle_not_found handle_exception StandardError => :handle_error
private
def authenticate! token = request.get_header("HTTP_AUTHORIZATION")&.sub("Bearer ", "") halt 401, { error: "Missing token" }.to_json unless token payload = JWT.decode(token, Hanami.app["settings"].jwt_secret, true, algorithm: "HS256").first @current_user = user_repo.find(payload["user_id"]) halt 401, { error: "Invalid token" }.to_json unless @current_user rescue JWT::DecodeError halt 401, { error: "Invalid token" }.to_json end
def handle_not_found(_req, res, _ex) res.status = 404 res.body = { error: "Not found" }.to_json end
def handle_error(_req, res, ex) Hanami.logger.error(ex) res.status = 500 res.body = { error: "Internal server error" }.to_json end end end

pattern.name: ROM Relation and Repository
pattern.example:
# lib/myapp/persistence/relations/users.rb module MyApp module Persistence module Relations class Users < ROM::Relation[:sql] schema(:users, infer: true) do associations do has_many :posts end end
def by_id(id) = where(id: id) def by_email(e) = where(email: e.downcase) def active = where(active: true) def with_posts = combine(:posts) end end end end
# lib/myapp/repositories/user_repo.rb module MyApp module Repositories class UserRepo < ROM::Repository[:users] include Deps[container: "persistence.rom"]
commands :create, update: :by_pk, delete: :by_pk
def find(id) = users.by_id(id).one def find_by_email(email) = users.by_email(email).one def all_active = users.active.to_a def count = users.count
def all_paginated(page:, per_page:) users.active .order { created_at.desc } .limit(per_page) .offset((page - 1) * per_page) .to_a end end end end

pattern.name: Operation
pattern.example:
# lib/myapp/operations/users/create.rb require "dry/monads"
module MyApp module Operations module Users class Create include Dry::Monads[:result] include Deps["repositories.user_repo", "services.password_hasher"]
def call(params) return Failure(email: ["already taken"]) if user_repo.find_by_email(params[:email])
user = user_repo.create( email: params[:email].downcase.strip, name: params[:name].strip, password_digest: password_hasher.hash(params[:password]), created_at: Time.now, updated_at: Time.now, )
Success(user) rescue => e Hanami.logger.error(e) Failure(base: ["An unexpected error occurred"]) end end end end end

pattern.name: ROM Migration
pattern.example:
# db/migrate/20240115000001_create_users.rb ROM::SQL.migration do change do create_table :users do primary_key :id column :email, String, null: false, unique: true column :name, String, null: false column :password_digest, String, null: false column :role, String, default: "user" column :active, TrueClass, default: true column :created_at, DateTime, null: false column :updated_at, DateTime, null: false end
add_index :users, :email, unique: true end end

quick-reference.item: Bounded contexts — each slice is isolated with its own actions/views
include Deps["key"] — no globals, no singletons
Return Success/Failure — never raise for domain errors
Validate params block, check .valid?, delegate to operation, pattern-match result
ROM::Repository subclass — only data access, no business logic
combine(:assoc) for eager loading in ROM relations
Settings class from ENV — never ENV[] directly in app code
halt 401/403 in authenticate! method called from before hook in base action
